instruction: This environment provides three candidate engineering applications, including BIM-capable applications and a distractor application. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable application yourself. Basic Single-Room Office. Start from a blank BIM project with no init files or reference images. Build or edit the model using real BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the selected BIM application's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. Model one rectangular single-storey office room about 5 m by 4 m with exterior walls about 3 m high, one floor slab, one real Zone named OFFICE 101, one door, and one window. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named OFFICE 101. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 1 IfcSpace zone, at least 4 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 1 IfcDoor element, at least 1 IfcWindow element. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 5 m, Y span 4 m, and Z span 3 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
